notes.title: Major Bug Fixes
notes.content:
Dear Users,

Thank you for supporting Gest! for long time.

And, please excuse me for not updating Gest! for long time.

This update fixes many minor bugs and some major bugs.



 Fixed VCRUNTIME140.dll issue.
 Fixed dangling reference bug. -> Now Gest! launches without any issues!
 Added logs for debug purpose.
 Changed logic to prevent dangling reference.
 Fixed memory leaking.


I'm always thankful for your patience.

Thank you.

Jio Choi.

notes.title: Update : Bug fixes!
notes.content:
Dear Users,

Thank you so much for using Gest!
This update mainly focuses on the bugs mentioned on steam discussions tab.

This update now fixes F13 - F24 shortcut keys, which previously didn't displayed correctly.
It also fixes a bug that prevented computer from entering into sleep mode.
Gest! now does not prevent computer from sleeping!

Thank you, again.
Jio Choi.

notes.title: Update : Now Support 8 Languages!!
notes.content:
Dear users,

I'm glad to say that now Gest! supports 8 languages:

 English
 Korean
 Japanese
 Russian
 German
 Spanish
 Simplified Chinese
 Traditional Chinese


Those languages are chosen based on the users of the Gest!
I hope that you all around the globe can now use Gest! without any problems of language.
However, those languages are translated using Google Translator, so it could have some mistranslations.
If you find any of those mistranslations or suggestions, please contact me.

Thank you.
Jio Choi.

notes.title: Gest! User Guide
notes.content:
Using Gestures
Using gestures with mouse
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42272455/23bb2a30b1df3f99a399704bd6be4d4cd64348fb.png
Place mouse cursor on the window that you want to execute the gesture and press and hold the right mouse button. Then, draw the gesture and release the mouse button. Gesture will be executed!!


Using gestures with touchpad
* Requires extra configuration.
Just like how you use the gesture with mouse, place the mouse cursor on the window. Put three fingures on the touchpad and draw the gesture. Now, release your hand, then gesture will be excuted!!



Configuring Gestures
Opening Gest Configurator
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42272455/9371be3d08b5c25e5de8475fdbc252e725a37829.png
Open the program tray by clicking the arrow icon on the right below.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42272455/02db0a8d37ff288bc4b8bcf64ff82e53315d202d.png
Place the mouse cursor on the Gest! icon. Then click the mouse right button.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42272455/495e741f97d8d9a66dc46751571f87cee858902d.png
Click the item Settings in the menu.


In All Programs
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42272455/adf729bb743ec26a21853f728cf68bb0377cd953.png
Click In All Programs in the program list on the right side.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42272455/a2b261030dc527bbea75df07f0c619806a215e5b.png
Click the gesture you want to modify.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42272455/b3d9112e3a48e5317b03fd747402e46f862a0d50.png
Choose the action you want to assign to the gesture.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42272455/9923f29cc018a942e96df8fe4467bf4195f8baa3.png
Now you can use the gesture that you configured!


In specific programs
Here explains how to assign different gestures for specific programs.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42272455/de659f31112564d39a69dc2affb7c66508c3b49f.png
If the program you want to assign the gesture is not in the list, click the refresh button.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42272455/7b35a7773e9871d0f566713ba35ed054b6373cb7.png
Click the program you want to change the gesture.
Now, you can change gestures just like how you did in previous steps.


Disable Gestures
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42272455/769a3d9ea1637b31581512c4ad30c9942403cd3c.png
Find the program you want to disable the gesture, and click the green button next to the name of the program. Now, the button changes to red, and Gest! is disabled for that program.


Disable Gestures In All Programs
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42272455/f3458a67bb9ce43c1b09b824191ee3be0c7c80de.png
Click the green button next to the In All Programs item in the program list. Now, Gest! is disabled for all programs that's not configured.



Configuring Touchpad
Disable default touchpad gesture
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42272455/bc6f55231c9a48f2e250d6d166bde801c72edaa0.png
Click Devices in Windows Settings.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42272455/96e7379c850dfd8d7a23bcf8b24011284eda7cb5.png
Click Touchpad item in the left list.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42272455/3d93bad6a62dbc2abc67d9c8e689af957af3ef4c.png
Change Three-fingure gestures to Nothing.


Configuring the touchpad
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42272455/8f66e040df1d5f840898d248b0fb85acd46b7a6b.png
Click General tab in the Gest Configurator.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42272455/9780b214bef2cf6b36bdca408512c7b2262d7c64.png
Click the button with PID and VID corresponding to the touchpad.

Tip: try pressing all the PID and VID buttons and try gesture with three fingures. You might be able to easily figure out the touchpad you want to configure without knowing the PID and VID.
